raw_response:
This small plot is just for my family's food — I grow sweet potato here, like my mother did. I cannot waste money on chemical fertilizer for tubers when my maize plot needs the little coupon fertilizer we get. I will put the manure from my few chickens and the ash from the kitchen on this plot, and use the vines I saved from last season. My daughter and I will do all the work ourselves; this plot is too small to pay anyone.
